parties: DPSC Limited (Corporate Debtor); India Power Corporation Limited (IPCL); Committee of Creditors (CoC)
headline: DPSC Limited files Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process notice; 5th CoC meeting of India Power Corporation Limited scheduled
sum: DPSC Limited intimated NSE of a Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) filing related to India Power Corporation Limited (IPCL). The 5th meeting of the Committee of Creditors was formally notified under Regulation 30 of LODR 2015, signalling continued creditor engagement in the resolution phase.
implication: NSE Regulation 30 disclosure obligation for listed entities in CIRP requires real-time CoC meeting notices; this precedent confirms that holding-company or linked-entity insolvency disclosures must flow through exchange channels even when the primary debtor may be unlisted, triggering strict timing and transparency rules for creditor coordination.
detail: DPSC Limited, likely a listed holding or investment entity, formally informed the National Stock Exchange of an ongoing Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016. The intimation relates to India Power Corporation Limited (IPCL) and flags the fifth meeting of its Committee of Creditors. Under Regulation 30 of the LODR 2015, listed companies must disclose all material events, including CIRP milestones, to the exchange. The CoC is the creditor body responsible for approving resolution plans and key decisions during insolvency; the 5th meeting suggests earlier rounds of deliberation have occurred and the process is in an advanced phase.
